name: Chapters and Bookmarks
author: Vestra Player
description:
Lists the media's chapters; adds, names and manages bookmarks for each file; jumps between chapters and bookmarks and shows them as marks on the seek bar.
The other commands are in the command palette under "Chapters and Bookmarks". A-B Loop is in the Playback panel (Basic Playback).
→ Press H: Chapter and Bookmark List
